selectedFunctions.label: OpenCover refundUnfulfilledQuote insurance quote
warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI metadata only; no persistent runtime attestation, underwriting/backing, claim eligibility, financial safety, liquidity, successful execution or complete-workflow assurance. Existing grants, policies, pause overlays and canonical calldata/value controls remain mandatory.

Base Quote proxy currently resolves to Quote/QuoteV16 implementation 0xc570375d36e602338615a613fa395bd89a2c6f7b. Historical repository README implementation is stale and is not used. BaseScan reports Exact Match for current implementation; Blockscout fully verified=true, partial=false, verified twin=null. These grades are retained as reported, not relabelled Sourcify exact_match.

Quote signatures are preexisting OPERATOR_ROLE counterparty price proofs, not wallet permits or backend authority grants. Source hashes fixed QuoteSubmission terms; V15 additionally binds coveredAddresses, integratorId and mintTo; V16 additionally binds coveredNonEvmAddresses. ECDSA personal-message recovery must have OPERATOR_ROLE. Source does not domain-separate chain/contract, nonce, or prevent proof replay; signatures do not bind payer, but every purchase pulls only msg.sender payment. No new backend message/typed-data signing capability is added. Decode canonical fixed ABI yourself; never accept opaque API-generated calldata.

Cover amounts use configured cover-asset units; premiumAmount and feeAmount use configured payment-asset units, summed exactly without quote-level conversion/rounding. coverExpiry is days; validUntil and settlement timestamps are Unix seconds. Provider/product/asset configuration and amounts/expiry bounds are checked; these configurations are administrator-mutable.

Purchases pay premium+fee. Native payment sentinel 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE requires msg.value exactly totalPayment. ERC20 path pulls msg.sender via existing allowance and does not reject additional msg.value: send zero native value for ERC20 purchase. Token approval is a separate prerequisite and is not admitted here.

Purchase creates a soulbound proof NFT, not immediate guaranteed cover: operator must separately fulfill/settle and record external cover txHash/expiry. V1 proof mints to payer; V15/V16 use signed mintTo, defaulting zero to msg.sender; coveredAddresses/non-EVM strings are coverage identifiers only, not executable payloads. NFT safe mint invokes the fixed ERC721 receiver callback if recipient is a contract; no arbitrary executor input exists.

refundUnfulfilledQuote requires existing caller-owned NFT, unsettled/unrefunded quote and expired settlement period (submittedAt+current provider settlementPeriod < block.timestamp); returns premium+fee to nonzero withdrawTo, which may differ from caller. It decreases pendingAmounts before native empty-data transfer or configured ERC20 transfer. Settled, active/expired-cover purchases cannot use this self-service refund. No claim payout, cover cancellation, capital-provider staking or complete insurance-claims workflow is added.

whenNotPaused and nonReentrant apply to selected methods; modifier presence does not establish current live pause state. Operator settlement/refund/collection, administrator configuration, owner upgrades, ERC721 transfer/approval and all role methods are excluded. Mutable asset mapping is also used during refunds, and metadata dependency is required; dependencies are not independently runtime-attested.
